warning: Made for no one in particular, so not adapted to any injury: skip or ease off anything that hurts.

workouts.title: Full body
workouts.about: Every major muscle, a steady build and an easy finish: the best first one.

workouts.title: Strength
workouts.about: Legs, push and pull with a chair: slow, controlled sets that leave you stronger.

workouts.title: Cardio
workouts.about: Get your heart rate up with no jumping: intervals that suit any room.

workouts.title: Mobility
workouts.about: Hips, back and shoulders, slowly: for a stiff day, or after sitting too long.

workouts.title: Core
workouts.about: A strong middle, from the inside out: bracing, holding and turning, kind to the back.
